web_search.label: Web search
web_search.description: Searches the web and cites the sources (Anthropic runs the search; $10 per 1,000 searches).

web_fetch.label: Web fetch
web_fetch.description: Loads the content of a web page or a PDF from a URL.

code_execution.label: Code execution
code_execution.description: Runs Python in a sandbox at Anthropic. Not together with web search/web fetch.

builtinTools.calculator: Evaluates an arithmetic expression exactly instead of calculating in its head. Supports + - * / // % **, parentheses, pi, e and the functions sqrt, log, log10, exp, abs, round, min, max, sin, cos, tan.
builtinTools.current_datetime: Returns the current date, time and weekday in a time zone.
builtinTools.days_between: Counts the calendar days from one date to another.
builtinTools.text_statistics: Counts the characters, words, sentences and paragraphs of a text.
